messages:
emma: Opening follow-up for the brief inter-region spike last night. Observed rapid route flips that correlated with TLS handshake retry spikes and LB ejections. Need owners and timelines.

noah: I pulled the route-sync logs. We had a burst: ~95 pushes in 90s around 2026-06-11T01:08. Snippet: ```2026-06-11T01:08:03Z route-sync WARN apply timeout after 4s```

zain: I'll own a short-term proxy debounce to suppress identical edits for 12s and emit proxy.debounce.suppressed_count. ETA 2026-06-17 (canary -> prod).

emma: Add an alert too: proxy.debounce.suppressed_count > 40 for 10m -> P2, and a per-cluster dashboard heatmap.

zain: added. ops-bot created INF-2334 "route-sync churn -> proxy debounce + LB jitter" https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2334 (assigned zain,noah).

noah: For LB side, proposal: add small jitter (75-300ms) between TLS handshake retries and cap retries to 2 for cross-region backends. I can roll canary in ap-northeast-1. ETA 2026-06-15.

emma: Also want a regression harness: simulate 60 edits in 30s against staging and assert handshake retry rate < 0.6%. Who can prototype?

riley: I can build the harness. PR by 2026-06-13. Will include k8s loop and a Prometheus assertion.

noah: Short-term plan summary: zain -> debounce + metric + alert (due 06/17), noah -> LB retry jitter + canary (due 06/15), riley -> test harness (due 06/13), emma -> postmortem doc + deploy correlation (due 06/12).

emma: Added reproducer to the postmortem: `for i in $(seq 1 80); do kubectl apply -f route.yaml; sleep 0.25; done` then monitor `sum(rate(lb_tls_handshake_retries_total[5m])) by(cluster)`.

ops-bot: Weekly check-in for INF-2334 scheduled: 2026-06-14T16:00Z. Invitees: zain,noah,riley,emma.

noah: Deployed debounce to staging 2026-06-12T09:20Z. Simulated churn -> suppressed_count=72 and handshake retries down ~78%.

emma: We'll run a 24h prod canary during low traffic (03:00-03:00 UTC window) before broad rollout.

emma: Closing notes: track long-term fix for controller reconciliation (cache race) as a research ticket. I'll file it after collecting traces. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
